content: OWASP CSRF cheat sheet: Signed Double-Submit Cookie is RECOMMENDED; message = sessionID.length!sessionID!random.length!randomHex, token = hmacHex.randomHex, cookie Secure not HttpOnly; bind to authenticated session id that changes each login; no timestamps; login CSRF via pre-sessions, regenerate session on auth; __Host- prefix blocks sibling-subdomain overwrite; naive double-submit bypassable by cookie-writing sibling subdomain.
